description: This file defines React hooks and functions for managing tooltips in the Notesnook mobile app, including showing, hiding, and handling tooltip events.

methods.name: hideAllTooltips
methods.description: Hides all active native tooltips by clearing timers and dismissing each tooltip.

methods.name: useTooltip
methods.description: React hook that provides functionality to show tooltips at specified positions with auto-hide and shadow effects.

methods.name: useTooltip.present
methods.description: Function to trigger the display of a tooltip identified by a specific ID.
